caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden table with a rectangular top and four turned legs. The table is colored in various shades of brown, giving the appearance of natural wood grain. The tabletop is flat and smooth, supported by an apron that runs along all four sides beneath it. Each of the four legs is cylindrical and elaborately turned, featuring several bands and curves along their length. The legs are connected near the base by stretchers, which are also turned and have symmetrical bulges at regular intervals, forming a rectangular support structure. The table is centered within the drawing, which is framed by a faint rectangular border on a plain, off-white background. There are no other objects or decorative elements present in the composition.
title: Table
